sources.title: Nuclear Isomers: A Primer
sources.author: Ashok Kumar Jain, Bhoomika Maheshwari, Alpana Goel

study_focus: four fundamental physical mechanisms of nuclear isomers (spin traps, seniority, K-isomers, shape isomers)
seniority scheme in single j-shell and mid-shell B(E2) destructive cancellation theorem
K-selection rules in axially deformed nuclei and reduced hindrance power law f_nu ~ 100
triaxiality-induced K-mixing and anomalous hindrance collapse (f_nu << 10) in A~130 nuclei
double-humped fission barriers, second superdeformed minima, and WKB penetration lifetimes
